title: Get up to 85% off the Dead Space games in EA's franchise sale, including Motive's excellent remake that will probably never see a successor
partialText: Dead cheap.

title: The creator of Stephen's Sausage Roll has released a new puzzle-platformer where you play as an egg, in the latest example of a developer fallen to the sunny side
partialText: But should you give Oeuf a fry, or ovoid it entirely?

title: Throwback XCOM successor Xenonauts 2 leaves early access in April, though the developer says the milestone 'doesn't mean our work is done'
partialText: "We're planning to continue improving and patching the game after launch."

title: 22 years later, this classic Half-Life zombie survival mod shambles onto Steam with all new features
partialText: Zombie Panic! arrives with a new fatigue system, reworked maps and "zombie vision".

title: Marvel Rivals made Blizzard ask 'what if we could just drop 30 new heroes into Overwatch?' and inspired its biggest update ever
partialText: The competing hero shooter "definitely had an impact" on Blizzard.

title: Baby Steps' designers trolled players by placing stacks of cans at the top of 'plausible' climbing challenges they didn't even bother testing, and players managed to climb them all—except one
partialText: Baby Steps' designers accidentally made an impossible challenge, so players set out to prove it possible.

title: Major investor is 'shocked and sad' that the games industry is 'demonizing' generative AI
partialText: At GDC 2026, the rift between big tech and creative workers was easy to see.

title: The lyrics to the rap song about John McAfee, annotated
partialText: Virtual insanity.

title: Marathon's murderous audio change was an 'overcorrection,' Bungie admits, promises to pull it back in an upcoming update
partialText: Nobody liked that.

title: Amidst high profile live service failures, Arc Raiders production director says he hopes other studios are 'given the same chance we had, because it's so hard to put a game out'
partialText: Arc Raiders got to reinvent itself. Many other games can't.

title: How to beat Vantom in Slay the Spire 2
partialText: Take down Vantom as fast as possible before this fight gets too slippery to beat.

title: How to beat the Doormaker boss in Slay the Spire 2
partialText: Make quick work of the Doormaker or else face its replenishing health.

title: Should you eat the Byrdonis Egg in Slay the Spire 2?
partialText: Eating the egg gives a short term gain, but taking it under your wing can pay off bigtime.

title: 'No matter what we changed, somebody was going to get mad:' After hearing what an Obsidian dev went through to get RPG difficulty right, I get why nobody's ever gotten RPG difficulty right
partialText: There may not be an RPG with a proper difficulty curve.

title: Disco Elysium writers marvel at how a game made 'in a f**king squalid flat' in Estonia had such a huge impact, and welcomes successors like Esoteric Ebb: 'We make games, but we also like them'
partialText: Disco Elysium was one-of-a-kind when it came out in 2019, but that won't be the case for ZA/UM's upcoming Zero Parades.

title: Japanese furniture brand reveals the Electric Gaming Bed 2, the 'forbidden layout' built for the 'supremely decadent'
partialText: Wouldst thou like to recline deliciously?

title: Starfield's composer says the game will become 'legendary', Todd Howard's a 'visionary', and maybe you 'were just not ready for it'
partialText: "Eventually people will understand his vision."

title: As rumors about new a Witcher 3 expansion continue to swirl, CD Projekt pointedly says it has 'no plans for additional DLCs or expansions'—for Cyberpunk 2077
partialText: My dad used to pull this kind of thing on me, too.

title: Arc Raiders could one day get vehicles, but Embark says no promises: 'We have prototypes from seven years ago'
partialText: Imagine gunning it across Spaceport on a dirt bike.

title: Palworld's Bucky got off a plane to find 'about 8,000 Discord messages from Palworld fans' who really wanted him to know about Pickmon: 'God bless their little hearts'
partialText: There is not a soul in Palpagos who forgot to message Bucky.

title: Dead By Daylight devs reckon the game has 'at least' another 10 years in it
partialText: "We just made a game ready to walk away. But it worked, and people wanted more, and so we gave them more."

title: Arc Raiders once had jump pads and the Snap Hook made you 'like Spider-Man' before its extraction shooter pivot: 'It was much more heroic'
partialText: Jump pads and unrestrained Snap Hooks didn't stick the landing, but I can't say I don't want to see them return.

title: Google is adding official Chrome support for users running Arm and Linux and it's about time
partialText: Anything to help Linux users feels like a good shout.

title: 'We want that the real-time images look indistinguishable from reality. We want them to look like a film.' Nvidia has lofty goals for path-traced graphics, but its support for Microsoft's shader stutter cure is a lot more interesting to me
partialText: Can't brute force your way to path tracing nirvana, so it'll be AI all the way into the future of graphics.

title: Arc Raiders' devs didn't expect such a passionate PvE-only crowd
partialText: "It's quite challenging because we have these two, quite polar [types of] fans."

title: I'm celebrating Spring by helping a little frog wake up from hibernation in the cosy puzzle game Walk the Frog
partialText: On my way to Froggapalooza.

title: Notorious UK rights group launches legal action against Valve for distributing music in games on Steam without a license
partialText: The Performing Right Society says a license to use music in a game does not constitute the right to distribute that music, via the game, to the public.

title: Here's 8 minutes in nostalgic benchmark heaven, with me running 3DMark2001 on an RTX 5090 to celebrate its 25th birthday
partialText: Released March 13, 2001 MadOnion's 3DMark 2001 was an instant PC graphics classic.

title: Microsoft teams up with Nvidia, AMD, Intel, and Qualcomm to share 'our dream of bringing console-level GPU developer tools to Windows'
partialText: It could be laying the foundation for whatever the Xbox division is cooking up, too.

title: You've got a narrow window to nab OpenTTD on Steam for free, because Transport Tycoon Deluxe has just been un-abandonwared by Atari
partialText: Get rolling, tycoons.

title: Arc Raiders' old machine designs sound so diabolical, it's no wonder they were reworked or removed after poor playtest feedback: 'At that time, they didn't fit with the game very well'
partialText: "There's still interesting gameplay to have with them," so never say never.

title: 2 years after its announcement, FF14's monster-taming Beastmaster job finally arrives this year, along with what looks like a Slay the Spire-esque roguelike mode
partialText: Maybe I've just been putting in too many runs.

title: It's been 25 years since my jaw first dropped at 3DMark2001's Nature test but hoo boy, have 3D graphics changed since then
partialText: Dated and clunky, just like me.

title: 'GeForce 3 was such a transition for us': Nvidia's Jensen Huang looks back on 25 years of the classic graphics card
partialText: Feeling nostalgic?

title: 'It was supposed to be the greatest time ever': Jeff Kaplan only got 6 weeks to come up with and pitch Overwatch: 'We were probably the most demoralised we'd ever been'
partialText: Overwatch beat out an intergalactic RPG and a StarCraft MMO.

title: The first thing Arc Raiders' devs did during its extraction pivot was to reduce the speed of everything by 60%: 'All the craft that was in the game was kind of background noise'
partialText: It was a speedrunner's dream, but it didn't work.

title: Microsoft removes its 'This is an Xbox' marketing campaign and is slowly purging all mention of it
partialText: See you, space cowboy.

title: Major copper foil supplier raises prices by 12%, potentially ushering in a fresh wave of spikey prices for PCBs and plenty of PC components besides
partialText: Getting worse before it gets better.

title: Fortnite players revolt over V-Bucks changes as Epic devs appeal for calm: 'Paying the bills frees up our teams to continue driving stories and building stuff you love'
partialText: A Fortnite boycott is planned for March 19.

title: Over 48% of unreleased games have a Discord server, and I'm sure this is all fine and normal and I don't miss forums at all
partialText: How did we get here?

title: Journey composer Austin Wintory played an unreleased song from his canceled 'dream job of all time' during the Game Developers Choice Awards, just to drive home that the industry's doing great
partialText: Host Sam Maggs also named several canceled games that will never see the light of day.

title: Two laugh-out-loud moments in Zero Parades gave me hope that the Disco Elysium successor will still deliver flashes of brilliance
partialText: Two locked doors, two surprisingly funny and nuanced dialogue puzzles.

title: Former EVE Online developers are building a society simulation MMO where your character keeps playing even after you log off
partialText: Long-in-the-works colony sim MMO Seed is shaping up into something that looks like EVE Online for RimWorld fans.

title: Shadowstone, the new game from Secret Door and Dreamhaven, kicks off a surprise public playtest at the Future Games Show Spring Showcase
partialText: The playtest is scheduled to run until Shadowstone launches into early access.

title: Blizzard vet Rob Pardo closed this year's GDC keynote by urging executives to cool it with the layoffs: 'The game team is more valuable than the game itself'
partialText: Somebody does have to make the next one, after all.

title: Path of Exile's new Mirage league might be the best chance you'll ever get at obtaining the rarest item in the game
partialText: This map's so nice I'll run it twice

title: Turing Award winner Tony Hoare, computing pioneer who invented the Quicksort algorithm for a sixpence bet, dies at the age of 92
partialText: "You know, you shouldn't trust us intelligent programmers."

title: Marathon got deadlier overnight, and some think yesterday's sound change is the culprit
partialText: "Can't shoot a single bullet without free kitted Assassins third-partying me in succession."

title: Former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan's favorite hero is Reinhardt, and reveals his charge was inspired by Left 4 Dead 2: 'It's what separates a great Rein from a sh*tty one'
partialText: Kaplan says he prefers simple hero designs above all.

title: Dave the Diver DLC adds a little Stardew Valley time management and relationship building to the formula when In the Jungle releases in June
partialText: I'm scheduled for a fistfight with eels at noon.
